artists.biography:
Jurassic 5 were an American alternative hip hop group formed in 1993 from members of two previous groups, Rebels of Rhythm and Unity Committee by rappers Charles Stewart (Chali 2na), Dante Givens (Akil), Courtenay Henderson (Zaakir), Marc Stuart (Mark 7even), and disc jockeys Mark Potsic (DJ Nu-Mark) and Lucas Macfadden (Cut Chemist). The six piece crew that was formed, came out of the Los Angeles, California Venue called "Good Life". The group broke up in 2007, shortly after releasing their fourth LP Feedback, citing "Musical Differences".
In 2014, they started touring again, headlining at Glastonbury.

perplexity.description:
Quality Control is the second studio album by Jurassic 5, released in June 2000 by Interscope Records. The album arrived nearly seven years after the group's formation, establishing them as a significant force in underground hip-hop during an era when alternative rap was often perceived as overly serious and self-important. Jurassic 5 distinguished themselves by channeling the infectious energy and collaborative spirit of classic crews like the Furious Five and Funky Four Plus One More, while maintaining their own contemporary identity. The production, helmed by Cut Chemist and DJ Nu-Mark, showcases inventive sampling and scratching techniques that anchor the album's funk-driven sound.

The album's musical approach balances artistic substance with genuine fun, rejecting the dour self-seriousness that characterized much of the underground hip-hop landscape at the time. Standout tracks like "Quality Control" exemplify the group's strengths, featuring a beat constructed from Blowfly samples that creates a rolling groove, while the lyrics articulate the crew's commitment to artistic standards over commercial pandering. The album also incorporates influences from the late-'90s swing music revival, with creative production choices that blend hip-hop sensibilities with broader musical references.

Quality Control solidified Jurassic 5's reputation as skilled lyricists and innovative producers within the alternative hip-hop community, marking a pivotal moment in their career trajectory and contributing to the era's most respected underground releases.
